infrastructure.name: Evidence Hub
infrastructure.description: Install and launch approved Evidence products.
requirements: Production downloads and self-update require independently reviewed release trust and an Authenticode publisher pin.
releaseNotes: Development preview adds the shared product catalog and release details.
Managed Genesis installs keep game, runtime and model separate and reuse verified unchanged components.
Imported installations remain playable offline; existing files and saves are preserved.
The separate Hub bootstrap updater requires signed metadata, a known publisher and protected release approval; production trust is not configured.

products.name: Genesis
products.description: A teachable 2.5D AI companion game with local inference and user-controlled memory.
requirements: Hardware with an OpenGL 3.3 graphics driver.
Minimum CPU and RAM requirements have not been benchmarked; local AI speed depends on available hardware.
Bundled local AI may require the Microsoft Visual C++ x64 runtime; the official prerequisite download needs internet.
releaseNotes: Development version 0.4 adds a main menu and isolated named workshop profiles.
Explicit read-only import preserves legacy internal save versions 2/3 and their original workshop files.
Durable task history records completion, failure and cancellation; failed save writes roll back in-memory changes.
Document export includes Markdown and printable HTML with lists; PDF is available through the browser print dialog.
Profile saves use compatibility epoch 4; older releases cannot read new profiles, and cross-epoch rollback stays blocked.
